title: Ashtray Radio w/ Spliffany b2b Spliffany Evans(Two Spliffs)
body: AHH ITS TWINNEM! GOOD MF VIBES ONLY! SUPAGOOD VIBES ONLY! AHHHHHSpliffany invites spliffany evans to kick off her residency.spliffany evans is an eclectic chicago-born open format DJ who uses internet culture, sound collage technique, black americanisms and dance music from across the african diaspora to create deconstructed, psychedelic, bass heavy soundscape. She has played shows with underground bass icons such as Foodman, DJ Manny and DJ Travella.
